cases.name: depth-0
cases.description: junction at depth 0 (bit 0 of the bitmap)

cases.name: depth-255
cases.description: junction at depth 255, the last bit (bit 7 of bitmap byte 31); the query shares 254 bits with both leaves and leaves the compressed edge at bit 254

cases.name: diverges-in-compressed-edge
cases.description: the query leaves the key set inside the compressed edge below the root junction: the terminal is the first leaf of its side and the certificate still authenticates

cases.name: empty-tree
cases.description: certified empty tree: empty certificate, UC with the empty input record hash

cases.name: full-depth-chain-included
cases.description: the same tree queried at its deepest leaf: all 256 bitmap bits set, 256 siblings, the 8288 byte maximum certificate (the terminal is the query)

cases.name: full-depth-chain
cases.description: 257 leaves diverging from one path at every depth 0..255; the absent query leaves that path at depth 254: 255 junctions, 8256 byte certificate (the longest absent one)

cases.name: golden-two-leaf
cases.description: rugregator/Rust golden vector: leaves 00..00->01..01 and 80 00..00->02..02, query 01 00..00, root 5158a5f4...7a53

cases.name: random-16
cases.description: seeded random tree of 16 leaves, random absent query (math/rand seed 20261016)

cases.name: random-5
cases.description: seeded random tree of 5 leaves, random absent query (math/rand seed 20261016)

cases.name: random-64
cases.description: seeded random tree of 64 leaves, random absent query (math/rand seed 20261016)

cases.name: shared-prefix-included
cases.description: the query is a leaf of the shared prefix tree

cases.name: shared-prefix
cases.description: keys sharing prefixes (junctions at depth 0 and 4): query follows the left subtree

cases.name: singleton-included
cases.description: the query is the only leaf: the terminal is the query, state included

cases.name: singleton
cases.description: one leaf: the certificate is the bare terminal (zero bitmap)

cases.name: under-quorum
cases.description: valid structure, but the seal carries fewer signatures than the quorum

cases.name: zero-root
cases.description: the UC certifies the 32 byte all-zero hash: it is NOT an empty tree, the empty certificate does not verify against it

cases.name: cert-bitmap-bit-moved
cases.description: a junction bit moved to another depth (same popcount): the fold uses the wrong depth

cases.name: cert-bitmap-extra-bit
cases.description: one more bitmap bit than siblings: length does not match the popcount

cases.name: cert-empty-against-nonempty-root
cases.description: the empty-tree certificate against a UC with a nonempty root

cases.name: cert-nonempty-against-empty-root
cases.description: a singleton certificate against the certified empty tree

cases.name: cert-oversized
cases.description: 8289 bytes: above the 8288 byte maximum

cases.name: cert-sibling-flipped
cases.description: first sibling hash altered

cases.name: cert-terminal-key-flipped
cases.description: terminal key altered below all junction depths

cases.name: cert-terminal-value-31-bytes
cases.description: terminal value one byte short (the profile fixes 32 bytes)

cases.name: cert-terminal-value-flipped
cases.description: terminal value altered

cases.name: cert-trailing-byte
cases.description: one byte after the terminal value

cases.name: cert-truncated
cases.description: last byte missing

cases.name: ctx-before-epoch-start
cases.description: the certified round precedes the epoch start of the trusted authority

cases.name: ctx-config-pin-ok
cases.description: the shard configuration hash equals the pinned one

cases.name: ctx-config-pin-other
cases.description: the shard configuration hash differs from the pinned one

cases.name: ctx-epoch-end-after
cases.description: the authenticated end of the epoch is after the seal round

cases.name: ctx-epoch-end-at-round
cases.description: the seal round is at the authenticated end of its epoch (retirement boundary)

cases.name: ctx-fresh-enough
cases.description: the certified round equals the required minimum

cases.name: ctx-too-stale
cases.description: authenticated but older than the minimum root round the caller requires: unavailable/stale, never accepted as current

cases.name: ctx-untrusted-authority
cases.description: a self-consistent but untrusted authority: not an anchor

cases.name: ctx-wrong-epoch
cases.description: the authority is of another epoch (reused keys): exact epoch is required

cases.name: ctx-wrong-network
cases.description: the authority is of another network (reused keys and node IDs)

cases.name: ctx-wrong-partition
cases.description: the UC is of another partition than the application expects

cases.name: query-diverges-at-last-junction
cases.description: full depth chain, query follows the path to a different terminal leaf than the certificate's

cases.name: query-is-terminal
cases.description: the query equals the authenticated terminal key: the state is included

cases.name: query-other-branch
cases.description: the query chooses the other branch at the root junction; the certificate is for the left side

cases.name: uc-empty-root-as-empty-byte-string
cases.description: the input record hash is the empty byte string (40) instead of native null (f6): not the empty-tree root; the signed shard path no longer holds either

cases.name: uc-empty-shard-id-with-sibling
cases.description: an empty shard ID with a sibling hash

cases.name: uc-input-record-altered
cases.description: state hash of the input record replaced: the shard path no longer reaches the seal hash

cases.name: uc-no-unicity-tree-certificate
cases.description: unicity tree certificate absent

cases.name: uc-nonempty-shard-id-without-path
cases.description: a nonempty shard ID with no sibling hashes (not the unsharded form)

cases.name: uc-null-partition-path-step
cases.description: null entry in the partition path

cases.name: uc-self-signed
cases.description: the seal content re-signed by an authority which is not the trusted one

cases.name: uc-signature-altered
cases.description: one root signature of the seal altered (witness bytes)

cases.name: uc-signatures-removed-below-quorum
cases.description: signatures removed from a valid seal until fewer than the quorum remain

cases.name: wrapper-block-noncanonical-integer
cases.description: block number encoded in a longer form than needed

cases.name: wrapper-certificate-as-text
cases.description: certificate is a text string

cases.name: wrapper-empty
cases.description: no bytes

cases.name: wrapper-legacy-uc-tag
cases.description: an empty array under the legacy tag 1007 instead of a native UC

cases.name: wrapper-proof-two-elements
cases.description: proof without the unicity certificate

cases.name: wrapper-three-elements
cases.description: outer array of three elements

cases.name: wrapper-trailing-bytes
cases.description: a byte after the wrapper

cases.name: wrapper-uc-as-byte-string
cases.description: the UC is a byte string holding its CBOR, not the native value

cases.name: wrapper-wrong-version
cases.description: version 2
